en: The image is a black and white postcard depicting a large, classical-style building partially obscured by trees. The building has a gabled roof and symmetrical window placement. There is a small guardhouse or entrance booth in front of the building. The upper left corner of the postcard contains text in both Russian and transliterated Russian (Omsk), along with a number and the term 'Военное собрание' which translates to 'Military Assembly'.
